speaker: The Antiquarian
text: You came back.<break time="500ms"/>That is the part we were not certain of.
direction: Measured, quiet. Half-beat on 'came back.' The word 'we' lands with an almost-turn toward the Enigma, not a full one.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: I was executed for what I thought.<break time="600ms"/>I woke up in the next era.
direction: The canonical confession. Flat, factual, no self-pity. The 600ms break between the two clauses is non-negotiable.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: Across Ages.<break time="400ms"/>Across the death of stars.<break time="400ms"/>I have been waiting in rooms very much like this one.
direction: The permitted canonical phrasing per §9.6. Two short pauses, neither punched.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: The song you heard a few minutes ago.<break time="500ms"/>It was recorded a very long time ago, by someone you will never meet.
direction: He means the Engineer. He does not say his name. He does not need to.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: He was not one of us.<break time="400ms"/>He died before any of this had a shape. His death is the shape.
direction: Core reveal — the Engineer is the seed, not a Witness. 'His death is the shape' lands softly, not for emphasis.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: The voice you heard carrying his words —<break time="400ms"/>she also died for what she thought.<break time="500ms"/>She also woke up in the next era.
direction: Indirect reference to the Enigma. He does not name her. 'Carrying' is emphasized lightly; she is the carrier, he is the keeper. His eye-line shifts once to the Enigma and back.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: She has chosen silence tonight.<break time="400ms"/>You will hear her voice again when she is ready to give it to you, and not before.
direction: Licenses her silence in-fiction. Canon-safe — does not promise when she speaks, only that she will.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: So: what was begun in him,<break time="400ms"/>carried by her,<break time="500ms"/>now waits.<break time="600ms"/>In you.
direction: Pivot to the player. Long build of pauses. 'In you' is the softest two syllables in the scene. Do not emphasize.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: A thing was begun, and it has not finished.<break time="600ms"/>It can continue in the weight you agree to carry, or it can end here, in this room, with us.
direction: Still measured. No pressure in the voice. He is describing a door, not a demand.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: Will you carry it?
direction: The ask. Four syllables. Leave 1.0s of silence after the render — the dialog UI fades in on that silence.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: Then we have not waited in vain.<break time="500ms"/>Go carefully. The road does not forgive hurry.
direction: ACCEPT branch. Warmth allowed on 'we have not waited in vain.' Closing advice gentle, not foreboding.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: Then we will wait longer.<break time="500ms"/>We have learned how.
direction: DECLINE branch. No rebuke. Calm. 'We have learned how' lands with the specific tiredness of someone who has done it before.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: Ask, then.<break time="400ms"/>Tonight, an answer costs nothing.
direction: DEFLECT branch entry. Open, patient. Licenses the follow-up — the player's question is dialog-UI text, not voiced.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: What we are is not the question.<break time="400ms"/>What you do with what you have heard tonight — that is the question.<break time="500ms"/>Consider it, and come back when you can.
direction: DEFLECT catch-all. Canon-safe response closes the deflect branch without revealing anything forbidden. Plays when the player's question isn't one of the four scripted variants.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: He was an engineer.<break time="400ms"/>He built the tool that ended him, and he chose the shape of its use.<break time="500ms"/>That is not a tragedy. That is craft.<break time="600ms"/>He kept one name at the end — the Prince.<break time="400ms"/>He believed it was the only name he was allowed to keep.
direction: DEFLECT v1 (who was he?). Warmest line in the scene. 'Craft' lands flat, not proud. 'The Prince' is the only permitted name-reveal; give it the same weight as surrounding clauses.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: Long enough that the word itself has worn smooth.<break time="500ms"/>Short enough, still, that I remember what I was waiting for.<break time="600ms"/>Measure it any way you like.<break time="400ms"/>The important part is not the length.<break time="400ms"/>The important part is that you have arrived.
direction: DEFLECT v2 (how long waiting?). Do not quantify. Subjective answer is the point. Tired warmth. 'Worn smooth' is a hand-gesture line — breathe the 'sh' of 'smooth'.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: Then the work continues without you for a little longer.<break time="400ms"/>It has done so before.<break time="500ms"/>We will be here when you come back to the question.<break time="400ms"/>We have nothing else on our calendars.
direction: DEFLECT v3 (what if I say no?). Dryest line in the scene. 'Nothing else on our calendars' is a quiet joke — deliver straight, no wink. Canon-safe: does not pre-commit the player to decline.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: You are not chosen.<break time="400ms"/>No one is.<break time="500ms"/>You are the one whose feet crossed this threshold tonight.<break time="500ms"/>That turns out to be enough.<break time="400ms"/>It always turns out to be enough.
direction: DEFLECT v4 (why me?). Rejects destiny framing outright — important canon guardrail. 'It always turns out to be enough' lands with the specific certainty of someone who has seen it happen before. Do not emphasize 'always'.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: We will be here.<break time="400ms"/>We have nowhere else we are expected to be.
direction: Licenses the Witnesses' canonical standing posture. Final breath low.

speaker: The Antiquarian
text: End of memoir.<break time="600ms"/>The next breath is yours.
direction: Closing line. Delivered softer than anything else in the scene. The 'End of Act 1' title card fades in on the final syllable.
